entries.mechanism:
TAXSIM runs at its latest 2024 law year and its siitax is final
liability net of credits, while the suite's Axiom/PolicyEngine side is the
2026 tax before non-refundable credits, so the residual decomposes into
three verified factors from TAXSIM's own detail output. First, TAXSIM's
before-credit tax staxbc is exactly 4.25 per cent (the SB 24-228
TABOR-triggered temporary 2024 rate) of wages minus the 14600 dollar 2024
federal standard deduction, i.e. 654.5. Second, siitax nets TAXSIM's
modeled 2024 TABOR sales-tax refund of 177.0 (exactly the 177-dollar
first-tier statutory refund for the 30,000-dollar single case; an
income-interpolated approximation of the section 39-22-2003 tiered refund
elsewhere, doubling for joint filers), giving siitax = staxbc - 177.0
= 477.5 exactly. Third, the pipeline computes 2026 law: 4.40 per cent
of wages minus the 2026 OBBBA-era standard deduction. Vintage plus
concept difference, not a pipeline defect; the pipeline matches
PolicyEngine at 2026 to the cent on every grid case.
